fields.title: eprocure.gov.bd tender record
fields.description: One record per row/tender. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_LIST (mode=list, one live-tender row), TENDER_AWARDED (mode=awarded, one Notice-of-Award row with supplier and contract value), or TENDER_DETAIL (mode=detail, a raw label/value passthrough of the tender's own detail page -- field set can vary slightly by procurement type, so extra fields beyond those listed below may appear). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a query/tender fails or is not found.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list/awarded records: 'latest' or a 'search:...' summary of the filters used. For detail records: the tenderId or URL that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-list, S1-awarded, or S1-detail on success, 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (not_found, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_totalPages.title: Total pages reported
_totalPages.description: TENDER_LIST/TENDER_AWARDED only -- eprocure.gov.bd's own reported page count for this query at the requested page size, before this actor's maxResults truncation.

tenderUrl.title: Tender detail URL
tenderUrl.description: Link to this tender's full detail page.

referenceNo.title: Reference number
referenceNo.description: The procuring entity's own tender/contract reference number.

referenceDate.title: Reference date
referenceDate.description: TENDER_LIST only -- the 'Dated:' date shown alongside the reference number.

procurementNature.title: Procurement nature
procurementNature.description: TENDER_LIST only -- e.g. Goods, Works, Service, Physical Services.

procurementType.title: Procurement type
procurementType.description: TENDER_LIST only -- raw text combining tendering type and method, e.g. 'NCT / OTM'.

pkgLotId.title: Package/lot ID
pkgLotId.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- eprocure's internal ID for the specific awarded lot.

ministry.title: Ministry
ministry.description: TENDER_AWARDED only (top-level ministry of the awarding entity).

packageDescription.title: Package description
packageDescription.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- brief text describing what was procured.

awardNoticeDate.title: Award notice date
awardNoticeDate.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- date/time shown alongside the package description.

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: TENDER_AWARDED (e.g. LTM, RFQ, OTM) or TENDER_DETAIL (e.g. 'Open Tendering Method (OTM)').

publishDate.title: Publish date
publishDate.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- date this award notice was published.

contractValueCroreBdt.title: Contract value (BDT crore)
contractValueCroreBdt.description: TENDER_AWARDED only -- raw text as shown, in crore Bangladeshi Taka (1 crore = 10,000,000 BDT).

lots.title: Lots
lots.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- list of {lotNo, identificationOfLot, location, ...} rows from the tender's own lot table, keys slugified from eprocure's own column headers (can vary by procurement type).

documentsUrl.title: Documents URL
documentsUrl.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- link to the tender's downloadable-documents listing page (not followed by this actor).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
